title: Vietnamese language 2 (Vietnamese language in economics and business 1)

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Recall, understand and use vocabulary and terminology related to various topics such as environment, tourism, trade, investment, marketing, and banking.
Practice exercises to develop specialized vocabulary and grammar skills in Vietnamese.
Listen and record key information from news broadcasts, dialogues, speeches, lectures, etc., related to various topics.
Speak confidently before class on prepared/unprepared topics related to various themes.
Write clearly and coherently about various topics with correct style and grammar.
Apply skills to find information about various topics within the course curriculum.
Recognize the importance of self-motivation in developing language skills.
Demonstrate active participation and readiness in language development activities and communication with native speakers.
